pr_title: Remove ReplayingDecoder and replace its usage with ByteToMessageDecoder
pr_body:
Motivation:

There is really no need for the ReplayingDecoder at all and all its use-cases can be implemented by using the ByteToMessageDecoder directly.

Modifications:

- Replace usages of ReplayingDecoder with ByteToMessageDecoder
- Remove ReplayingDecoder and related classes
- Remove the *Compatible* marshalling decoder / encoders as their usage was disencouraged anyway and make them work without ReplayingDecoder would be costly in terms of generating exceptions etc.

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/11659

issue_context.title: [Netty 5] Remove ReplayingDecoder
issue_context.body:
I propose we remove `ReplayingDecoder` in Netty 5.

The code might look convenient, but it's relying on simulating continuations with exceptions - a constant, but still.
It also needs to modify how `ByteBuf` behaves, while in the new `Buffer` API we wish to have maximally consistent behaviours.

If we remove the `ReplayingDecoder`, then the following decoders will have to be rewritten in terms of the regular `ByteToMessageDecoder`:

- [x] Socks5InitialRequestDecoder
- [x] MqttDecoder
- [x] StompSubframeDecoder
- [x] SocksInitResponseDecoder
- [x] Socks5CommandResponseDecoder
- [x] Socks5PasswordAuthRequestDecoder
- [x] CompatibleMarshallingDecoder
- [x] SocksAuthResponseDecoder
- [x] Socks5PasswordAuthResponseDecoder
- [x] WebSocket00FrameDecoder
- [x] Socks5CommandRequestDecoder
- [x] Socks4ClientDecoder
- [x] SocksCmdRequestDecoder
- [x] SocksInitRequestDecoder
- [x] Socks5InitialResponseDecoder
- [x] SocksAuthRequestDecoder
- [x] Socks4ServerDecoder
